title: Gilbert H Probable NDE 3448
content: At a given moment, my thoughts started wandering off and a bright white light arose around me, until I found myself in a kind of white room with a peaceful and serene atmosphere. Everything dear to me, family, partner, dog, seemed to have lost their importance (only I was important). After this phase, I was asked whether I wanted to live on. After an outspoken 'yes' (because I felt I was too young with still a lot of potential), I gradually woke up.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Direct head injury 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' Cerebro Vascular Accident, aneurysm.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: If I would divide the experience in three phases it would be the second one.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I experienced that time stood still.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain As I described earlier, I got slowly enveloped by light.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm een van, zoals boedha omschrijft, bewustzijn zonder wervelingen.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control The relativity. The beauty enclosed in the relativity of 'ephemeral' life.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I am convinced about God/Allah/energy. I try to live as good/aware as possible, without harming myself or others.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I am convinced about God/Allah/energy. I try to live as good/aware as possible, without harming myself or others.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes This life is ephemeral, but part of the cosmos.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I don't judge people anymore, and other people's judgment about me is not so relevant anymore.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I don't judge people anymore, and other people's judgment about me is not so relevant anymore. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Describing what happened is not difficult; but to convey the emotions in the experience is difficult.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Primarily realizing that you have influence over your own life.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes After a couple of weeks. It made my life with the people around me more difficult because one cannot transfer the experience.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Uncertain I had heard about it as a phenomenon, but never heard about experiences.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real [Plato?] It was real for me, and whatever anybody says about it, for me it is an authentic experience.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real See former question.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes Three years later I experienced a moment of 'enlightenment' or nirvana. My NDE had a more subjective influence on me. The second experience had more influence on the environment/cosmos and the way I cope with it.
